title: Reported workflows
description: Workflows that members reported. Review each report, then dismiss it, resolve it, or take the workflow down.

detail.title: Report detail
detail.notFoundHint: This report does not exist or the address is wrong.
detail.forbidden: You do not have permission to view this report.

history.title: Moderation history
history.empty: No moderation action has been taken on this workflow.

dialog.failed: Could not apply this action. Try again.

hide.title: Hide workflow
hide.description: Members other than the owner can no longer find or open this workflow. The owner keeps full access. You can restore it later.

remove.title: Remove workflow
remove.description: Members other than the owner can no longer find or open this workflow. The owner keeps full access. You can restore it later.

restore.title: Restore workflow
restore.description: The workflow becomes visible to members again and its share links work again.

dismiss.title: Dismiss report
dismiss.description: Close this report without any change to the workflow.

resolve.title: Resolve report
resolve.description: Close this report as handled. The workflow keeps its current state.
